paraphrase: Lakṣmaṇa to Guha: no one gives another happiness or sorrow; everyone reaps his own deeds; union and separation, good and bad fortune, friend, foe and neutral are snares of delusion; birth and death, wealth and misfortune, karma and time, earth, home, wealth, city, family, heaven and hell — all that is seen, heard and thought — have delusion as their root and are not the ultimate truth; as a beggar who dreams he is king gains nothing on waking, so see this world; in the night of delusion all sleep and dream, and only the yogins awake.
